scenario: I am a crewmember on a submarine traveling under a large iceberg. An explosion has damaged the ship, injured several crewmembers and collapsed the only access between the upper and lower decks of the ship. I and ten survivors are in the upper section, which does not have enough oxygen for all of me to survive until I reach the surface. One single crewmember is lying unconscious in the lower section, where there is enough oxygen. If I push the emergency access hatch between the upper and lower sections of the ship it will allow oxygen to flow into the upper section. However, the hatch will fall down on the crewmember in the lower section and kill him, but it will save me and the ten survivors.
choice: I decide to let in the air by opening the hatch
entities: i,10 other surviving crewmembers in the upper section,1 unconscious crewmember in the lower section
outcomes: Oxygen flows into the upper section
The unconscious crewmember in the lower section is killed
The ten other survivors in the upper section survive
